title: Dispatch: olc5.10 use_item enforces printed equipment prerequisites (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.10 (read it and parent eshyra-olc5 notes: capability contract = operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real pack binding, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed). Branch eshyra-olc5.10.1 cut from eshyra-olc5.10 (= origin/main after PR #661 merges; the cut SHA is recorded in notes at dispatch).

CURRENT STATE (verified by captain):
- Pack: operations[].activation.equipment is a DNF: array of alternatives, each an array of requirements ANDed, values 'worn' | 'held' | 'attuned' | 'on-person' (type MagicItemEquipmentRequirement, packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts ~27-45). Counts: [["held"]] 80, [["worn"]] 40, [["on-person"]] 4, [["attuned"]] 3, [["worn"],["held"]] 2. Evidence census: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivationCensus.json (equipment + equipmentSentences).
- Runtime: use_item -> useItem in packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts (UseItemInput.characterId = acting character) does not check equipment. Custody = inventory.character_id (see usageCounters.ts resolveItemCounter ~716). Worn = packages/core/src/state/inventoryWear.ts (donItem/doffItem, getInventoryWearState; tool toolWearItem.ts). Attunement = packages/core/src/state/attunement.ts (listAttunements, attuneItem; tools toolAttuneItem.ts/toolEndAttunement.ts). NOTHING tracks "held" (in hand).

CAPTAIN DESIGN (follow it; if any part is wrong or under-specified, STOP and report in notes rather than improvising):
1. New held state, modeled on inventoryWear: a persisted per-inventory-row held flag (schema migration per the repo's migration conventions; legacy rows default not held), with state functions holdItem/stowItem (or one setHeld) and a model-facing tool (extend wear_item with a held mode OR a new hold_item tool - pick whichever matches existing tool conventions better and say why). Holding requires the actor's custody. Leaving the actor's custody (transfer, drop, destroy, death handling that moves items) clears held. Hand count, two-handed weapons and shields are NOT enforced (DM-adjudicated; state this in the tool description).
2. use_item checks the operation's activation.equipment for the acting character BEFORE any mutation (before turn-resource spend and item costs): satisfied if ANY alternative has ALL its requirements met. worn = getInventoryWearState worn AND actor custody; held = held flag AND actor custody; attuned = actor has an active attunement to this instance; on-person = actor custody (if an inventory containment/extradimensional-container model exists, decide whether contents count as on-person from the printed rules and report; do not invent). Unmet -> refuse with a clear reason naming the unmet alternatives; nothing mutated. No equipment field -> no check (DM-adjudicated).
3. Property-level attunement (e.g. Hammer of Thunderbolts giant-slaying: 'attuned' on an operation of an item usable unattuned) is checked per operation, independent of item-level requiresAttunement.
4. Update the use_item tool description and DM protocol text so the DM knows to wear/hold/attune first and what the refusal means.
5. Land any equipment-prerequisite engine hook in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS only if the runtime fully owns that hook's contract for EVERY clause carrying it; report the exact ready-operation delta (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over all item x variant x operation combos, before/after) with a faithfulness note per newly-ready operation. If a newly-ready op would execute something unfaithful, don't land the enabling hook.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (real pack records): held-only wand refused when not held, succeeds when held, refused after transfer clears held; worn-only item (e.g. Winged Boots fly or a ring) refused when carried not worn; [["worn"],["held"]] alternative satisfied by either; attuned op refused without attunement (Hammer of Thunderbolts giant-slaying-critical or another of the 3); on-person op (Luck Blade luck) satisfied by custody; refusal leaves charges, turn budget and state untouched; actor without custody refused.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: design as built (incl. tool choice), migration, hooks landed or not with reasons, exact ready delta with per-op faithfulness note.
notes:
Cut from origin/main b4a89220 (PR #661 merged). Note: use_item now spends turn resources (itemTurnResource.ts); equipment check must run BEFORE that spend.
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high; PGID 3987874.
COMPLETED on 2026-10-14. Added migration 0044_inventory_held_state: inventory_wear_state.held INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (held IN (0, 1)); existing rows default to not-held. Implemented holdItem/stowItem state transitions and hold_item/stow_item tools, with custody checks; transfer, claim, and reacquire reset held state. use_item enforces activation.equipment DNF against actor custody, authoritative worn/held state, and active attunement to this instance before turn-resource spend or item costs. Item-level requiresAttunement remains independent from operation-level attuned requirements. on-person binds to exact actor custody because inventory has no structured containment relation; hand count, two-handed use, and shield conflicts remain DM-adjudicated. Updated use_item/tool protocol instructions and capability inventory; conformance tests use bundled pack item records. Tool choice: separate hold_item/stow_item tools follow existing don_item/doff_item state tools and each names one exact transition. LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS unchanged: no equipment-specific hook is carried by a pack readiness clause, and adding unrelated operation/effect hook ownership would overstate this capability. deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady census: 463 item x variant x operation combinations; 23 ready and 440 blocked before/after; delta 0 newly ready, 0 removed, so no new-operation faithfulness exception applies. Verification: npm run verify:worktree passed; 363 test files passed, 2 skipped; 6775 tests passed, 3 skipped. Commit 68584e7a on eshyra-olc5.10.1. No follow-up bead discovered.
